name: Home zone

boundary.north: 9 Mile Rd (include businesses on BOTH sides of 9 Mile)
boundary.east: Lahser Rd (include businesses on BOTH sides of Lahser)
boundary.south: Plymouth Rd (include businesses on BOTH sides of Plymouth)
boundary.west: Newburgh Rd (include businesses on BOTH sides of Newburgh)

rule: A place is IN if its street address is on or inside the four boundary roads. Nothing north of 9 Mile, east of Lahser, south of Plymouth, or west of Newburgh unless it fronts that boundary road.
addressHints: Livonia E-W roads (Plymouth, 5/6/7/8 Mile): Newburgh is about the 37500 block. Corner plazas AT a Newburgh intersection count (e.g. New Five Plaza 37609-37685 Five Mile, SW corner). Laurel Park Place (37700 Six Mile, by I-275), Haggerty Rd, Victor Pkwy and Seven Mile/Haggerty are OUT.
Middlebelt ~29000 block, Inkster ~27000, Beech Daly ~25800-26000, Telegraph ~24000-25000 on E-W roads in Redford/Livonia numbering.

N-S roads: Plymouth Rd is ~11500-12000; Joy Rd (~9000-10000) is OUT. Schoolcraft ~13000, 5 Mile ~15000, 6 Mile ~17000-18000, 7 Mile ~19000, 8 Mile ~20000-20600. Ann Arbor Rd / Ann Arbor Trail addresses are OUT.
North of 8 Mile the west edge continues as Halsted Rd in Farmington Hills; 9 Mile is the north edge (both sides).
bboxNote: Approximate, with a small margin, for sanity checks only. Road-address rule above wins.
towns: Southfield (west of Lahser, south of 9 Mile)
Detroit (west side of Lahser / Plymouth Rd edge)
